description: Runtime Agent registration values the Operations read model shows. Go registration and heartbeat validation, the agent-registration and agent-heartbeat JSON Schemas, the Runtime models and the public RuntimeAgentObservation schema apply these grammars and bounds, so every registration the Server accepts yields a valid Operations snapshot. toolName is the public ConfigId grammar; identity is the public ResourceId grammar of instanceId and allocationId; capabilityRefs bounds each of supportedRuntimes, supportedToolsets and supportedSandboxProfiles and each ref in them, whose selector grammar config-identity-cases.json pins.
